brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Tallyline, the invoicing and cash-flow forecasting product in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: calm and trustworthy, friendly to freelancers, not the generic fintech blue-and-green. Web app only.

claim.notes: Üç yön (horizon, bridge, cairn) iki sketch turunda da critic'ten 'none' aldı ve reddedildi; kalite kapısına geçen konsept olmadığı için export, install-assets ve gallery çalıştırılmadı.

concepts.title: Crossing T
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 letter r/n plus block; s2 umbrella/fan with a block; s3 doorway or arch; s4 lowercase n (or m) / gate; s5 two blobs with a swoosh. No T now, but s1/s3/s4 are a different letter or a door, s2 is generic, s5 is two blobs and fails 16 px as a shape. Dropped.

concepts.title: Cairn
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 sliced stone/macaron; s2 diagonal-striped squircle (candy or pill); s3 sliced pie or play-like wedge; s4 split egg/pebble. All four fail 16 px thin cuts, stock-shape similarity 74-87 percent, and one pebble is not a cairn. Dropped.

concepts.title: Horizon
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 striped retro sunset; s2 striped dome/slabs; s3 half-disc with line; s4 pie chart wedge (growth-chart-adjacent); s5 striped sunset. Banded sun is the Outrun/synthwave sunset cliché and a half-circle sunrise is generic; s3/s4 fail 16 px. Dropped.
